Legacy (briefly known as Fake Natty) is a Brazilian professional esports organization founded in 2023 when 00 Nation's Brazilian division split from the company.

Timeline

[edit]
  • 2023
  • 2024
  • 2025
  • 2026
  • Show All
  • August 15th - Fake Natty is formed with the separation of 00 Nation's Brazilian division, taking the Brazilian lineup and staff with them. [1]
  • August 17th - Fake Natty transfer b4rtiN from their VALORANT division onto the team as an inactive player. [2]
  • September 22nd - Fake Natty's new name is revealed as Legacy. [3]
  • September 26th - Legacy release TACO. [4]
  • October 16th - Legacy loan b4rtiN to RED Canids. [5]
  • October 25th - Legacy bench nqz and recall b4rtiN from RED Canids as his replacement. [6][7]
  • November 11th - nqz is acquired by paiN Gaming. [8]
  • March 25th - Legacy bench coldzera by mutual agreement. [9]
  • March 29th - Legacy add Stewie2K as a stand-in. [10]
  • April 18th - Legacy release coldzera. [11]
  • April 30th - Legacy release n9xtz upon the end of his loan to Arena Jogue Fácil Esports. [12]
  • May 31st - Legacy part ways with Stewie2K as they acquire saadzin from w7m esports. [13]
  • November 23rd - Legacy bench b4rtiN. [14]
  • December 26th - Legacy bench NEKIZ. [15]
  • January 2nd - Legacy sign n1ssim. [16]
  • January 3rd - Legacy acquire lux from paiN Gaming. [17]
  • July 2nd - Legacy release NEKIZ and b4rtiN. [18][19]
  • December 19th - Legacy part ways with chucky. [20]
  • January 12th - Legacy sign RiVAS as their new coach. [21]
  • February 2nd - Legacy bench lux. [22]
  • February 3rd - Legacy acquire arT from Fluxo W7M. [23]
  • April 22nd - RiVAS steps down from the active lineup while adr takes over as interim coach. [24]
  • May 4th - Legacy acquire bobz on loan from Yawara E-Sports as an analyst until the end of the IEM Cologne 2026 Major. [25]
  • June 15th - Legacy bench n1ssim by mutual agreement. [26]
  • June 30th - Legacy release lux. [27]
  • July 9th - Legacy reinstate n1ssim to the starting lineup. [28]
  • July 10th - saadzin is acquired by Imperial Esports. [29]
  • July 11th - Legacy acquire try from Imperial Esports. [30]
